days.topic_en: A New Wave of Exhaustion — What the CDC's Fatigue Report Found

days.topic_en: Fatigue vs. Sleepiness — Learning the Real Difference
days.topic_cn: 疲勞 vs 嗜睡 — 認清兩者的真正差別

keywords.def: the length of time spent doing an activity, which can cause tiredness

keywords.def: tiredness of the mind or of the body

speaking.en: Try Dr. Ash's test — if you sit quietly right now, do you feel sleepy?
speaking.cn: 試試 Ash 醫生的測試 — 如果你現在安靜坐著，會想睡覺嗎？

speaking.en: Do you get enough sleep each night? How many hours do you usually get?
speaking.cn: 你每晚睡得夠嗎？通常睡幾小時？

speaking.en: Which do you experience more often — sleepiness or fatigue?
speaking.cn: 你比較常經歷「嗜睡」還是「疲勞」？

days.topic_en: Why We're More Tired Despite AI — Technology and the Hyperaroused Brain
days.topic_cn: 即使有 AI 為何更累 — 科技與過度警覺的大腦

keywords.def: increasingly, in a way that feels new

speaking.en: Do you think you spend "way too much time" on your phone?
speaking.cn: 你覺得自己花「太多時間」在手機上嗎？

speaking.en: Were you surprised that women and people aged 18-34 report more fatigue?

speaking.en: What does it mean for your brain to feel "hyperaroused"? Have you felt this way?
